name: Soothing Flames adds a 30% HoT after Kindle heals an ally (#5234)
contract: #5234: Soothing Flames 704855's Description reads 'Healing done by Kindle and Cinderheart now additionally heals the target for 30% of the healing done over $807403d' -- 807403 is a SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HEAL aura on the ally. aura_ascension_pyromancer_event::Check (AscensionPyromancerEvents.cpp) case 704855 returns Any(info, {800806, 803819}) for outgoing healing and Handle calls Accumulate(player, target, 807403, CalculatePct(healing, 30)), which SetAmount()s effect 1 of the 807403 aura to the raw 30%-of-heal total. A spell_proc row exists for 704855 and spell_script_names binds it to aura_ascension_pyromancer_event (rev_20260909_11_pyromancer_completion.sql); static reading of the whole gating chain found no obvious blocker, but the reporter states nothing happens, so this scenario reproduces it rather than asserting a fix: cast Kindle (803819) on an ally with Soothing Flames known and check both that the HoT aura appears and that its accumulated amount (effect 1) is 30% of the logged effective heal. No code or SQL change is made; the controller runs this to establish pass/fail.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
control: ally carries no Soothing Flames HoT before the cast
control: Kindle actually healed the ally
Soothing Flames applies its HoT to the ally
The HoT's accumulated amount is 30% of the logged Kindle heal
